findings.summary: register() re-reads each input schema file inside the registration loop after tool_specs() validated them, leaving a time-of-check-to-time-of-use window where an interleaved file replacement could partially register the toolset.

tool_specs() validates field presence but not field types: a non-string input_schema raises a raw TypeError outside the guarded loader, and value_bindings and optional_flags entries are stored without checking the keys resolve_argv indexes, deferring malformed-catalog failures past registration.
The manifest generator re-parses the catalog with json.loads outside the registry parse boundary instead of load_catalog(), splitting the parse contract across two modules.
build_manifest indexes catalog plugin-block keys directly and crashes with an unhandled KeyError on a missing or partial plugin block instead of the script's bounded failure report.
resolve_argv trusts that the caller validated parameters first; enforcement is owned by the EPIC-002 runner, which must validate against the frozen input schema before resolving argv.
